metadata.title: COPE Mobile SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned, Personally-Enabled (COPE) Mobile devices within the Secure-Mobile architecture.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits all constraints, guardrails, and trust semantics from the Secure-Mobile Platform SSPP.

system-characteristics.system-description: COPE Mobile devices are institution-owned mobile devices that permit limited personal use while enforcing strong security and explicit privacy boundaries. COPE Mobile operates under strict signal-based trust and never grants execution, administrative, or DAW-equivalent privileges.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: The institution owns the mobile hardware.

props.name: use-model
props.remarks: COPE Mobile devices support both institutional and limited personal use.

props.name: management-authority
props.remarks: The institution retains management authority constrained by explicit privacy and scope boundaries.

props.name: container-model
props.remarks: Institutional applications and data are isolated in managed containers separate from personal data.

props.name: privacy-boundary
props.remarks: Institutional visibility and control are restricted to managed application containers only.

props.name: execution-trust
props.remarks: COPE Mobile devices are never treated as trusted execution environments.

props.name: daw-eligibility
props.remarks: COPE Mobile devices may not be used for DAW or privileged access workflows.

props.name: baseline-security-posture
props.remarks: COPE Mobile enforces baseline hardening (CIS L1), continuous health evaluation, and runtime threat protection.

props.name: admin-context
props.remarks: Administrative and break-glass contexts are forbidden on COPE Mobile.

props.name: data-classification-ceiling
props.remarks: COPE Mobile devices may access data up to Classification Level 2, subject to Secure-Mobile containment and privacy rules.

system-implementation.remarks: COPE Mobile is implemented by applying the Secure-Mobile pattern stack with additional privacy boundary enforcement. Unlike COBO Mobile, COPE Mobile explicitly limits telemetry scope, administrative actions, and data remediation to managed containers only.

roles.title: COPE Mobile Service Owner
roles.remarks: Owns the COPE Mobile service offering and ensures enforcement of Secure-Mobile and privacy guardrails.

roles.title: COPE Mobile Operations
roles.remarks: Operates COPE Mobile devices, posture evaluation, telemetry, and lifecycle actions within defined privacy boundaries.

control-implementation.remarks: Security and privacy controls are inherited from the Secure-Mobile Platform SSPP and associated patterns. This SSPP relies on container isolation and selective management to enforce privacy boundaries without restating control implementations.
